sources.entry: Hoppscotch Community Edition - Fast and beautiful API request builder. (Source Code) MIT Nodejs/Docker
Hoppscotch | API development ecosystem, a Postman alternative

summary.one_liner: Hoppscotch is an open-source API development ecosystem for building and sending HTTP, WebSocket, SSE, Socket.IO, MQTT and GraphQL requests, available as a web app, desktop app, or self-hosted install.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a request builder where you choose an HTTP method, enter a URL, and send to view the response, with support for headers, parameters, request bodies, and authorization including Basic, Bearer, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC/PKCE. It also covers WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, Socket.IO, MQTT, and GraphQL (schema fetching and docs). Organization features include collections and folders, environments with variables, workspaces, and history. Pre-request scripts and post-request tests are written in JavaScript. The README also lists a proxy mode for CORS and blocked APIs, code snippet generation for 10+ languages, and official add-ons such as a CLI, a proxy server, and browser extensions. Sync across devices and team features are offered through cloud sign-in.
use_cases: share API requests with a team
send requests through a CORS proxy
how_to_run: Follow the self-hosting documentation referenced in the README to set up the development environment
notable: Covers HTTP plus WebSocket, SSE, Socket.IO, MQTT and GraphQL in one tool
Runs as a web app, PWA, or desktop app for Windows, Linux and macOS
Pre-request scripts and post-request tests written in JavaScript
Official CLI, proxy server, and browser extensions as add-ons
Import and export collections via file or GitHub gist
caveats: SSO is listed as an Enterprise edition feature
Team and cloud sync features depend on signing in to the hosted service; local storage is also supported
Self-hosting setup is described only by reference to external documentation
keywords: share api requests with my team
